title: Roscosmos Cosmonauts to Conduct Spacewalk Outside the Space Station
description: This computer-generated animation is a depiction of a scheduled spacewalk by Roscosmos cosmonauts Sergey Prokopyev and Dmitri Petelin outside the International Space Station to remove experiment hardware and install communications hardware. The spacewalk, scheduled for June 22nd, will be the seventh for Prokopyev and the fifth for Petelin, and the 266th spacewalk in support of station maintenance and upgrades.
keywords: Sergey Prokopyev, Dmitri Petelin, Russian Spacewalk 59
via: the NASA Image and Video Library

transcript.text: Russian spacewalk 59 will be  conducted by Sergey Prakopiev,
EV1 in the red stripes and Dimitri  Patelan, EV2 in the blue stripes.
To start the spacewalk, Crew will egress the  Poisk Airlock with a cable carrier bundle
and a data transmission radio monoblock. After  egress they'll activate the Orlan Sublimators,
turn on the helmet video and lights, then  begin translation to the Zvezda module.
After arriving at the first Zvezda patch panel,  the crew will open a Multi-Insulation Layer Flap
and mate a connector from the cable bundle  to the panel. They'll take closeout photos,
reinstall the flap, and begin routing the newly  installed cable to the zenith side of the module.
Once the crew completes the second cable mate,  Dimitri will retrieve the stowed radio monoblock
and follow Sergei down to the next worksite,  continuing to route the cable as they go.
Once Sergei and Dmitri arrive at the port Zvezda  module worksite, they'll work to remove two
existing monoblocks, a seismoprognos payload  and a high speed data transmission system. To
do this they'll release the connectors and locks.  Sergei will then proceed to jettison both items.
After jettison they'll release a final TM/TC  monoblock that Sergei will stow on his suit
while Dmitri proceeds to install the new  data transmission radio via structural locks,
4 connectors, and the release  of two protective shrouds.
Sergei will then take the TM/TC monoblock and  jettison the unit in the station aft direction.
Both crew will proceed further  aft along the Zvezda module where
they'll remove a science experiment and  take imagery of the plume deflectors.
Sergei will then translate to the aft face of  the module and retrieve a cassette container.
Meanwhile, Dmitri will proceed with  imagery of an antenna boom interface.
Crew will then meet back up and begin  translating station forward to the Poisk Airlock.
They'll stow the remaining hardware from  the Zvezda module tasks and continue to
the final worksite of the day at  the top of the Poisk module. Here,
they'll have a short task to retrieve a Biorisk  payload before continuing back to the Airlock.
After inspecting each other's suit,
the crew will ingress and close the  hatch, ending Russian spacewalk 59.
